label: Jump Pay Mult
description: Extra crew pay when jumping out of a populated system, as a multiple of crew salary. Zero disables this charge.

label: Spacer Share Threshold Salary Months
description: Savings protected from the spacer lifestyle charge, measured in months of crew salary.

label: Spacer Share Per Month
description: Monthly fraction of eligible savings spent by the spacer lifestyle. 0.10 means 10%; zero disables it.

label: Retirement Min Cycles
description: Earliest retirement cycle offset. Zero disables ordinary retirement checks. The date is rolled at campaign creation; changing this later does not reroll it.

label: Retirement Max Cycles
description: Latest retirement cycle offset. Must be at least the minimum. Used when the retirement date is first rolled.

label: Retirement Delay Cost Base
description: Starting monthly rejuvenation cost in credits. Stored when the retirement script is created.

label: Retirement Delay Cost Per Month
description: Credits added to rejuvenation costs each month after postponing retirement.

label: Retirement Delay Cost Max
description: Maximum monthly rejuvenation charge in credits.

label: Ship Buy Price Mult
description: Ship purchase price multiplier by hull size. 1 means the normal-mode reference price; 5 means five times that price before other modifiers.

label: Pristine Ship Sell Price Mult
description: Resale multiplier for pristine ships by hull size, combined with the game's ordinary ship resale factor. It is not a percentage of the purchase price.

label: Ship Sell Value Increase Per Part Used
description: Credits added to resale value per Domain-grade Part spent repairing the ship, with the game's repair-count cap.

label: Ship Sell Value Mult Per SMod
description: Resale bonus per built-in S-mod. The multiplier is 1 + this value times the number of S-mods.

label: Ship Storage Price Mult
description: Multiplier used for the ship value underlying storage charges. Lower values reduce that component of storage fees.

label: Ship Buy Price Mult Per DMod
description: Remaining purchase-price fraction per D-mod. 0.85 leaves 85% per D-mod; smaller values make damaged ships cheaper.

label: Weapon Price Mult
description: Weapon base-price multiplier. 1 restores the normal-mode base price; 10 means ten times that price.
evidence: starfarer_obf.jar: BaseWeaponSpec.getBaseValue (dynamic getter, inspected with javap)

label: Fighter Price Mult
